jobs.title: D365 Finance & Operations Integration Developer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a D365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Integration Developer to join the Technology Consulting practice within a premier global professional services firm. In this role, you will design, develop, and support robust enterprise integrations between D365 F&O and external systems using Azure Integration Services. You will collaborate with functional consultants, architects, and international client teams to build scalable synchronous, asynchronous, and event-driven integration solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop enterprise integrations between D365 F&O and third-party applications.
Build integration architectures using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, and API Management.
Implement D365 F&O integration components using Data Entities, OData, REST APIs, DMF, Business Events, and Custom Services.
Apply synchronous, asynchronous, and event-driven integration patterns for scalable data exchange.
Implement data transformation, exception handling, retry mechanisms, logging, and security protocols across integrations.
Translate functional specifications into detailed technical integration designs alongside architects and client leads.
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, deployment, and operational troubleshooting across project environments.

Candidate Profile

Level of Experience:
4 to 6 years of hands-on integration and development experience with D365 F&O or Dynamics AX.
Azure Integration Stack:
Strong proficiency in Azure Integration Services, specifically Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, and API Management.
D365 Frameworks:
In-depth technical knowledge of D365 F&O integration tools (Data Entities, OData, DMF, Business Events, REST APIs).
Protocols & Data Standards:
Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON / XML, data parsing, and enterprise integration patterns.
Security & Governance:
Experience implementing security controls using OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, and Azure Key Vault.
DevOps & Operations:
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI / CD pipelines, version control, and error monitoring / logging frameworks.
Soft Skills & Mobility:
Strong problem-solving skills, effective client-facing communication in English, and willingness to travel occasionally as required by project needs.

Nice to Have

X++ development skills and experience with the D365 F&O extension framework.
C# / .NET development background, particularly for Azure Functions and custom components.
Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Event Grid, Application Insights, or Azure Monitor.
Experience integrating D365 F&O with CRM, banking, WMS, e-commerce, or tax platforms.
Exposure to EDI / B2B messaging and high-volume data integration scenarios.
Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Azure certifications.
German or French language skills.

Working Model & Logistics

Employment Type:
B2B Contract
Location:
Poland (Remote)

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (Java + Angular)
jobs.description:
Realizacja usług w Warszawie (orientacyjnie 1x w tygodniu biuro, 4 dni zdalnie)
💰22 000 – 25 000 PLN + vat na B2B

Wspólnie z naszym Partnerem z branży ubezpieczeniowej
poszukujemy doświadczonego/ej specjalisty/ki do świadczenia usług jako Fullstack Developer (Java + Angular).

Projekt dotyczy budowy nowego systemu detekcji nadużyć w obszarze obsługi szkód i świadczeń, realizowanego w ramach wieloletniego programu transformacji opartego na mikroserwisach, automatyzacji i AI.

💡 ZAKRES USŁUG:

Aktywne wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI i podejścia Agentic AI w procesie wytwarzania oprogramowania, podczas analizy wymagań, implementacji, testowania i utrzymania rozwiązań.
Projektowanie, implementacja i utrzymanie API oraz integracji między systemami, z uwzględnieniem komunikacji zdarzeniowej opartej na Apache Kafka.
Współtworzenie standardów wytwarzania oprogramowania oraz udział w spotkaniach koordynacyjnych w ramach wielodyscyplinarnego zespołu zwinnego.
Rozwijanie testów automatycznych oraz stosowanie dobrych praktyk inżynierskich, w tym wykonywanie i uczestniczenie w code review.
Budowanie i rozwijanie systemów w architekturze mikroserwisowej wspierających procesy zgłaszania i obsługi szkód.
Tworzenie aplikacji frontendowych w Angular oraz rozwijanie warstwy serwerowej w Java i Spring Boot.

🔍 WYMAGANE KOMPETENCJE:

Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia
jako Java Developer
oraz bardzo dobra znajomość Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud i Hibernate.

Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w pracy z Apache Kafka
oraz znajomość mechanizmów zapewniania odporności (resilience) w systemach rozproszonych.
Znajomość automatyzacji testów jednostkowych i integracyjnych (J Unit, TestNG, Spock
), BPMN
oraz narzędzi do diagnostyki wydajności aplikacji.
Doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji frontendowych z wykorzystaniem Angular
oraz znajomość programowania obiektowego i funkcyjnego.
Bardzo dobra znajomość SQL
oraz doświadczenie w pracy z Docker i Kubernetes.

Biegła znajomość języka polskiego oraz angielskiego na poziomie B2.

Mile widziane: Spock, Helm, Rabbit MQ, Elasticsearch, DDD.

✨ OFERUJEMY:

Nowy sposób na aplikowanie z AI Rekruterem (AIR) – w trakcie procesu możesz porozmawiać z wirtualnym rekruterem 24/7, bez czekania na telefon. Finalną decyzję zawsze podejmuje Opiekun Projektu.
Współpracę w modelu projektowym, z rozliczeniem opartym na etapach i protokołach odbioru poszczególnych deliverables.
Wsparcie po stronie Connectis w sprawach administracyjnych i rozliczeniowych związanych ze współpracą.
Uczestnictwo w wydarzeniach branżowych oraz meetupach technologicznych.
Realizacja usług w Warszawie (orientacyjnie 1x w tygodniu).
5 000 PLN za polecenie znajomych do naszych projektów.
Elastyczna forma współpracy B2B.
Szybki i zdalny proces.

Dziękujemy za wszystkie zgłoszenia. Pragniemy poinformować, że skontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami.

jobs.title: Senior/Strong Middle Scala Engineer
jobs.description:
Drivers of change, it’s your time to pave new ways. Intellias, a leading software provider in the automotive industry, invites you to develop the future of driving. Join the team and create products used by millions of people in the world.

Intellias is partnering with a Fortune 100, Midwest-based industrial manufacturer to modernize and expand a suite of cloud-based services and data products used by a global network of dealers, enterprise customers, and internal business units. Our cross-functional teams deliver scalable APIs, event-driven services, and analytics pipelines that power quoting, ordering, asset telemetry, diagnostics, and lifecycle support for heavy equipment in the field.

Your Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Scala.
Build reliable event-processing, notification, and integration services.
Develop APIs and distributed system components in highly available environments.
Deliver scalable, fault-tolerant solutions that provide business value.
Contribute to system architecture, technical design, and engineering decisions.
Troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Support integration, acceptance, and quality assurance testing activities.
Maintain high software quality through testing, reviews, documentation, and best practices.
Mentor engineers and promote technical excellence within the team.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in Agile environments.
Own services throughout their lifecycle, from design and development to deployment and production support.
Ability to provide 6 hours overlap with US Central Time (CT)
on business days (till 2 pm CT latest).

jobs.title: Mid Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Mid Full Stack Developer

Location: Remote (European Time Zone)-once per month in the office in Cracow

Contract Type: B2B

About Us:

ETFBOOK is a Swiss SaaS company providing data, analytics, and custom solutions in the Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) space. Founded in 2020, we aim to make global ETF data accessible, actionable, and valuable for institutional participants, including ETF issuers, index providers, fund service providers, market makers, exchanges, and buy-side institutions.
We develop a platform which offers comprehensive insights through a user-friendly web application and robust APIs, covering areas such as product analysis, fund flow tracking, performance comparisons, and liquidity assessments.

About the role:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer with interest in Frontend development to join our fully remote team spread across Europe.
You’ll join a highly skilled technology team. This team develops and maintains a cutting-edge data analytics platform using most advanced technologies to support all core business functions. You’ll be a part of a collaborative team focused on the application development. This role offers the chance to make a visible impact in a dynamic, fast-evolving field.

Requirements:

4+ years of experience in Web Application Development, the latest: C#, .Net and Angular
Strong communication skills in English.
A commitment to delivering value to the customer.
An emphasis on automation and code quality (we employ automated testing and deployment).
A can-do attitude, willing to roll up your sleeves, but also capable of thoughtful problem-solving before diving in.
Basic knowledge of Azure
Good communication skills.
Eager to learn.
Able to work under supervision.
Shows basic autonomy in assigned tasks.
English - min B2.

Responsibilities:

Development and maintenance of the frontend part of our application, the latest Angular.
Development of backend services the latest .NET - various APIs and Data Processing.
Participation in Solution Design and Requirements Analysis and Requirements Analysis.

What we offer:

100% remote work from anywhere within the European time zone.
Competitive B2B contract.
Exciting growth opportunities in a fast-paced startup.
Impactful work: help revolutionise ETF data market, currently fastest growing area of finance.
Have a real impact of developing products: your work will directly influence live projects, delivering measurable results in real-world applications.
Culture of innovation: collaborate with forward-thinking professionals in technology and finance where experimentation and creativity are encouraged.
Team- buildings events at least twice a year, hosted in various European locations.

Show more

Show less

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Industries

Financial Services
